episodes.157229: Cool and unstable air mass in a post-frontal air mass brought showers and a few thunderstorms generating hail.

events.narrative: Nickel sized hail fell in the Warrenton area.  There were other reports of 0.25 to 0.7 inch hail in the Warrenton and Astoria at about the same time. There was one report of 0.5 inch hail covering the road up to 1 inch deep in Astoria.
